text:
nodes
Description
This command behaves like active_nodes but lists all nodes in a pool,
not just nodes that are currently active.
Syntax
nodes
[
-list
]
<
pool
>
nodes <pool>
Returns the number of pool nodes.
nodes -list <pool>
Returns a list of the pool nodes.
Examples
#!/bin/bash
echo
"Active:Total members for $1: `curl -s http://172.18.201.234/pool/<partition>/$1`"
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
set
in_path
[
HTTP
::
path
]
log
local0.
"debug request: path $in_path"
switch
-
glob
$in_path
{
"/pool*"
{
set
pool
[
string
map
{
"/pool"
""
}
$in_path
]
HTTP
::
respond
200
content
"[active_members $pool]:[nodes $pool]"
}
}
}
